evidence.name: Screen field: Font for the field
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Font for the field" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Font for the field
sections.description: Picks the font used for both the placeholder hint and what the visitor types. Leave it on the system font unless you have a brand font, and match whatever the rest of your funnel uses. Consistent type keeps the page feeling polished and trustworthy, which matters when you're paying for the traffic.
